findings.headline: Migrate this batch call to default batching or flush(fn).
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 removes batch. Writes are batched by default and applied in a microtask, and flush(fn) runs fn and then applies its writes synchronously, which is the timing 1.x batch(fn) had; flush is a dev error inside an action body, is not re-entrant inside onSettled or tracked effects, and warns inside effect callbacks, all of which 1.x batch allowed.
findings.guidance: Read the complete callback, its reactive writes, and what runs right after the call. Replace batch(fn) with flush(fn) where a caller reads the written values synchronously after the call and the call is not inside an action, onSettled, tracked effect, or effect callback; drop the wrapper and keep fn's body where nothing reads synchronously.
